tools.name: track-download
tools.description: Hand a just-grabbed download to n8n, which watches it and messages the group itself when it finishes, gets stuck, or runs long. Call this immediately after a successful sonarr-grab-release, radarr-grab-release, or a search command that grabbed something, then END YOUR TURN and tell the user you will report back - do not poll the queue yourself. id must be the SONARR EPISODE ID (from sonarr-episodes or sonarr-wanted-missing) or the RADARR MOVIE ID, because that is what the app reports back when the import completes. chat is the group the request came from; pass it through from the conversation.

id.description: Sonarr episode id, or Radarr movie id

title.description: Human label, e.g. 'Ted Lasso S04E08' or 'Dune Part Two'

chat.description: WhatsApp chat id to report back to (the group this was asked in)

note.description: Anything worth repeating back, e.g. the release name that was grabbed
